# manta_bss_boot_parameters (Resource)

Add new boot parameters for one or more components.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manta_bss_boot_parameters" "default" {
  macs   = [node.mac]
  kernel = var.bss_kernel
  initrd = var.bss_initrd
  params = var.bss_params
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hosts` (List of String)
- `initrd` (String) URI of initrd/initramfs
- `kernel` (String) URI of kernel
- `macs` (List of String) one or more MAC addresses whose boot parameters to add
- `nids` (List of String) one or more node IDs whose boot parameters to add (default [])
- `params` (String) kernel parameters
